verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS Unix-like terminal, and developer tools of this kind could plausibly ship an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not show any AI agent, any issue-assignment flow, or any pull-request generation. Its only programmatic surfaces are local Shortcuts actions, an optional relay server, and the user-scripted `.profile` startup file, none of which delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request
